title: Colts' kicking competition remains neck-and-neck between Blake Grupe and Spencer Shrader

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts' kicking competition remains neck-and-neck between Blake Grupe and Spencer Shrader
sources.description: Last year the Colts started the season with Spencer Shrader as their kicker and finished the season with Blake Grupe taking Shrader's place after an injury.
